scope: Four-parameter Heston complete63quotes; existing immutable bank; no online generation, no new MCMC, no new bank.

control.role: Saved100k final500 estimator; reuse without refitting.

training.role: Training; actual visits recorded per candidate.

development.role: Inspected development; all5kvalidation rows already influenced historical epoch selection.

historical_acceptance.role: Already inspected Oct28; prohibited as fresh final test.

displayed_cases.role: Conservatively excluded, including legacy teaching cases even if producer differs.

final_confirmation.role: Reserved before study; open once only after frozen finalists/control; no tuning afterward.

unused_buffer.role: Not needed by this bounded study.

data_use_audit.scope: Tracked task-specific run declarations, journals, plans and teaching IDs inspected for role metadata. No final-confirmation parameters, quotes or outcomes were opened. A reservation does not prove unrecorded human usage did not occur.
data_use_audit.finding: Historical acceptance covers test0..1999. Validation0..4999 is development. test2500..4499 is disjoint from recorded Heston evaluation/teaching IDs examined; only metadata reviewed.

optimizer.name: AdamW
optimizer.schedule: CosineDecay parameterized by each candidate own update budget

fixed_training.data_order: Seeded permutation of all training rows per pass; fixed within-pass batches including the last short batch. Keras shuffle=False. No IDs in neural conditions.
fixed_training.noise_stream: Deterministic independent standard-normal quote noise keyed by seed and scheduled batch; probes do not consume a new batch stream.

confirmation.selection: Among candidates passing all development gates, measured total cost; freeze before confirmation. Keep all seeds and failures.

conditional.uncertainty: Retain chains/autocorrelation; mean/quantile reference and neural MC uncertainty. Threshold-crossing uncertainty is inconclusive, never pass.

uncertainty_calculation.block_length: max(ceil(draws_per_chain^(1/3)), ceil(2*chains*draws_per_chain/min(saved bulk and tail ESS across parameters))); also double L
uncertainty_calculation.resampling: Independent circular blocks within each retained chain; paired parameter rows; neural rows resampled IID.
uncertainty_calculation.intervals: Approximate normal with two-sided Bonferroni adjustment; maximum MCSE over both block lengths, reference mean MCSE floor.
uncertainty_calculation.decision: Pass only if entire intervals lie within the mean and width margins; wholly outside fails; overlap is inconclusive.

final_gates.bootstrap: Simultaneous one-sided95% paired bootstrap over observation IDs, preserving cross-model/target pairing; family covers all finalists,seeds,parameters,levels.

resources.admission: Do not launch matrix until saved-control gates pass, exact-cap smoke passes, memory/time forecast plus reserved final cost fits. Run independent lanes; no automatic extension.
resources.fallback: If no candidate qualifies by30000updates, retain existing full model.
